8D.
Extend use of temporary lights at Leo Mullen Sports Park for Encinitas Express. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Recreation Services Manager Hamer
Approve and authorize the City Manager in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute Amendment No. 8, extending the compliance agreement for one additional year between the City of Encinitas and Encinitas Express for use of temporary lights at Leo Mullen Sports Park.
2023-04-12 Item 08D Amendment No. 8 Temporary Lights for Encinitas Express
8E.
Adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2023-02 amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 11.08 and repealing Chapter 11.09 establishing a citywide smoking ban in all public places. CASE NUMBER: PLCY-005913-2023; LOCATION: Citywide. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the provisions of the California Environmental Quality Act ("CEQA") pursuant to Section 15308 of the CEQA Guidelines because it is an activity undertaken "to assure the maintenance, restoration, enhancement and protection of the environment" and pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) because there is no possibility that the activity in question may have a significant effect on the environment. To the extent that the ordinance applies to places of employment, it regulates working conditions by ensuring that employees and volunteers are not exposed to the harmful effects of second-hand smoke and is therefore categorically exempt from CEQA pursuant to Section 15324(c) of Title 14 of the California Code of Regulations ("CEQA Guidelines"). Section 15324(c) exempts regulation of "working conditions where there will be no demonstrable physical changes outside the place of work." Contact Person: Sustainability Manager Najera
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2023-02, titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas amending Chapter 11.08 (Smoking) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to establish a citywide ban on smoking in public places, and repealing Chapter 11.09 (Smoking Prohibited in Beaches, Parks, Trails, and Outdoor/Patio Dining Areas of Eating Establishments) of the Encinitas Municipal Code."
2023-04-12 Item 08E Smoking Ban Adoption
8F.
Extension of Facility Janitorial Services and Lock Up Contract for Parks Facilities. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Stratakis
City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 4 with Blue Moon Management Corporation for Facility Janitorial Services and Lock Up Contract, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form, increasing the Contract not to-exceed amount by $112,344 for an additional six-month term.
2023-04-12 Item 08F Blue Moon Contract Extension
8G.
Off-cycle Budget Amendment for Emergency Mold Remediation and Repairs to Encinitas Fire Station 6. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Stratakis
1) Appropriate $143,229 for emergency repairs to the Fire Station 6 project (CF23B) from the Facilities Maintenance Fund 403; and 2) Adopt Resolution 2023-33, titled, " A Resolution of the City Council of The City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2022-23 Budget."
2023-04-12 Item 08G Budget Request for Emergency Repairs FST#6
8H.
Award a construction contract for the Moonlight Beach Barrels and Storm Water Repairs Project (CD05E) to Beador Construction Company, Inc. Environmental Considerations: The proposed project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301 (c) of the CEQA Guidelines. This section exempts projects characterized as minor alterations to public facilities, involving negligible or no expansion of the existing site. The proposed project meets the criteria for this exemption. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Cabrera
cleaning, repairing and lining existing 72-inch metal storm water pipes; removal and replacement of damaged gabion retaining wall in kind; and repairing fencing and sinkhole at Moonlight Beach State Park.
2023-04-12 Item 08H Award Construction Contract Moonlight Beach
8I.
Ratification of Emergency Purchase of one fire apparatus for the Fire and Marine Safety Department. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. The proposed apparatus for purchase will help the City achieve its Climate Action Plan (CAP) goals because the fire apparatus will contain a diesel engine and can be fueled by renewable diesel, which has less emissions than regular diesel. Contact Person: Management Analyst Horn
1) Adopt Resolution Number 2023-24, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Ratifying the Emergency Purchase of a City Fire Apparatus;" 2) Adopt Resolution Number 2023-29, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Adopted Fiscal Year 2022-23 Adopted Budget;" 3) Adopt Resolution 2023-30, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Declaring its Intent to issue Tax-Exempt Financing to be Used to Reimburse the City for Qualified Expenditures Prior to the Issuance of Such Financing;" and 4) Authorize staff to seek long-term financing for the Pierce Stock Enforcer Pumper Fire Engine from Pinnacle Public Finance, on a negotiated basis, and to return to Council with the financing proposal and related documentation for Council approval.
2023-04-12 Item 08I Emergency Fire Apparatus Ratification
8J.
Emergency Declaration for Sinkhole Repair on El Camino Real just north of Via Molena, Update on City-Wide Storm Drain Repair Costs to Date, and Request for Additional Funding of $1,500,000 for All City-Wide FY 22/23 Storm Drain Repair Projects. Environmental Considerations: The actions being considered by the City Council are exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because emergency repairs to essential facilities are exempt from CEQA review under Section 15269. Contact Person: Engineer I Stryker
1) Approve the Emergency Declaration for Sinkhole Repair and Replacement of 24-inch Corrugated Metal Pipe on El Camino Real just north of Via Molena; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2023-26, titled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2022-23 Budget" to appropriate $1,500,000 to Project No. CX23A, Emergency Repairs - Storm Sinkholes.
2023-04-12 Item 08J Emergency Declaration ECR Sinkhole

Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: City Manager Antil

(EFFA), thereby rescinding both the policy and the side agreement with EFFA. (Rescinding of agreement with the Service Employees International Union (SEIU) will be brought forward separately on another date.)

Introduction of Ordinance No. 2023-03 adding Chapter 3.28 (Cannabis Business Tax) to Title 3 of the Encinitas Municipal Code establishing a Tax on Cannabis and Hemp Business Activities within the City and adopting Resolution No. 2023-21 setting forth the Specific Tax Rates for the Cannabis Business Tax. Environmental Considerations: The Ordinance and Resolutions are exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act, Public Resources Code sections 21000 et seq. ("CEQA") and 14 Cal. Code Regs. section 15000 et seq. ("CEQA Guidelines"). The Ordinance and Resolution are not projects within the meaning of CEQA because they create a government funding mechanism that does not involve any commitment to any specific project that may result in a potentially significant physical impact on the environment, pursuant to CEQA Guidelines section 15378(b)(4). Further, it can be seen with certainty that this Ordinance will not have a significant effect on the environment and is therefore exempt pursuant to section 15061(b)(3). Contact Person: Assistant Director of Finance Gallup
1) Introduce Ordinance No. 2023-03 titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California adding Chapter 3.28 (Cannabis Business Tax) to Title 3 of the Encinitas Municipal Code establishing a Tax on Cannabis and Hemp Business Activities within the City and amending Ordinance No. 2022-20;" and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2023-21 titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Setting Forth the Specific Tax Rates of the Cannabis Business Tax Pursuant to Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 3.28."

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
